messages:
rachel: CI SAST/DAST pipeline started erroring after last night's keystore RBAC rollout. failing step: evidence-ingest.

sec-bot: alert: 403 on keystore:GetKey for principal svc-scan-agent at 2026-03-21T03:04:12Z. Incident created INC-7219.

tom: can someone paste the exact error line? is it GetKey denied or bucket write?

rachel: log: ```ERROR upload: request=xx7a9 denied action=keystore:GetKey principal=svc-scan-agent key=secret/scan/artifacts```

ivy: we rotated group bindings to new-keystore-admins and forgot to add service-account subjects for the scanner alias. happened in the k8s rolebinding PR #678.

rachel: mitigation idea: flip a pipeline env USE_STAGING_KEY=true so the uploader uses staging key which has the old grant. need oncall signoff.

oncall: approving a 60-min emergency toggle to staging key. document audit note with PR id and approver.

tom: deploying flag now on ci. quick test: `./ci/upload --test` -> 200 OK, evidence id e-4791 stored. DAST run resumed.

ivy: long term actions: 1) add pre-rotation smoke `ci:upload-smoke` that must pass. 2) update rotation PR template to enumerate serviceAccount aliases. 3) enable keystore audit fields: full principal arn + roleBinding id.

rachel: adding incident artifacts to INC-7219: uploader logs, rotation PR diff, and smoke results.

oncall: please ensure compliance sees the audit trail for the emergency toggle. tag SEC-AUDIT.

tom: once RBAC fix merges, we'll run a full SAST/DAST run and validate evidence counts. also adding metric alert: keystore 403s > 5/min.

ivy: PR 679 adds svc-scan-agent to roleBinding and a post-merge job `keystore:verify` that runs `keystorectl whohas secret/scan/artifacts`.

rachel: closing urgent thread; follow-ups assigned: ivy (RBAC PR + audit logging), tom (pipeline gate), rachel (incident write-up).

sec-bot: INC-7219 -> resolved.
